summary: build_arg_defaults sets default build args (ANSIBLE_GALAXY_CLI_COLLECTION_OPTS, ANSIBLE_GALAXY_CLI_ROLE_OPTS, PKGMGR_PRESERVE_CACHE) that are hard-coded into the Containerfile; a CLI --build-arg overrides them.
questions: How do I install pre-release collections with ansible-builder?
Pass --no-deps to role installation in ansible-builder
